name: Sequestrion Extracts
source:
Too little, too late. What you think you see won't be there much longer.

Sequestrion Extracts is the sequel to 	
[url=/v37809]Sequestrion[/url], following the paths of formerly close friends.

[from [url=https://siilvalta.itch.io/sequestrionextracts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
太少，也太迟。你以为自己看到的东西，不会再存在多久。

《Sequestrion Extracts》是[url=/v37809]《Sequestrion》[/url]的续作，追随几位曾经亲密的朋友各自的人生道路。
